profile.reading:
This is a Digital Realty facility in Alameda County, CA, per mapping data, with no street address on file. Digital Realty operates a facility, OAK10, at 720 2nd Street, Oakland, CA, per its own property listing fetched this session, but this session did not confirm whether that record corresponds to this specific coordinate, so no operator-confirmed address or square footage is reported here rather than assuming the two are the same building.

Digital Realty Trust (NYSE: DLR, SEC CIK 1297996), headquartered at 2323 Bryan Street, Dallas, Texas, reported 310 data centers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, 221 wholly owned or consolidated and 89 in unconsolidated joint ventures, about 57.6 million rentable square feet across more than 55 metro markets including 118 US facilities, per its FY2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC. The company operates as a colocation and wholesale landlord rather than running its own compute, distinguishing it from hyperscaler tenants such as AWS, Google, or Meta, also tracked in this registry.

This building sits within Digital Realty's San Francisco Bay Area footprint, which includes carrier-dense downtown San Francisco buildings and additional sites across the East Bay, including Oakland. Digital Realty markets its Bay Area properties under its PlatformDIGITAL brand, positioning the metro alongside Northern Virginia, Chicago, Dallas, Silicon Valley, and New York/New Jersey, all tracked elsewhere in this registry, as core hubs in its global interconnection and colocation platform.

Digital Realty's FY2025 Form 10-K identifies the United States as its largest single national market by both facility count and rentable square footage, with the San Francisco Bay Area figuring among the company's longest-held US metros dating back to its original public listing in 2004.

reading.body:
This facility's individual critical IT capacity in megawatts is not confirmed from a tier-1 operator source in the available data. The address at 47700 Kato Road in Fremont, Alameda County, is confirmed as a Digital Realty operated site from explicit operator text, though the listing itself carries a confusing secondary reference that required flagging during research.

Digital Realty operates this campus as part of its Silicon Valley cluster, a concentration of assets in the Santa Clara and San Jose area that includes well-known carrier hotel buildings such as 360 Spear Street and 365 Main Street in San Francisco. The larger Digital Realty footprint in California shows 11 facilities with published capacity totaling 365 MW across the state, with this Fremont facility ranked outside the top 10 by published megawatts, meaning its capacity contribution to the state's mapped portfolio is not among the largest disclosed.

Without a published critical IT load figure for this specific building, its relevance to AI scaling cannot be assessed from the specifications available. The state context shows 103 mapped facilities in California but only 11 with published megawatt disclosures, indicating that most large data center operators do not publicly specify their per-campus capacity. Any assessment of this site's role in the grid constraint on AI would require capacity data that has not been disclosed.
